# Swipies AI

> Swipies is a platform for AI agents, chatbots, datasets and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). External AI assistants can manage tenant resources directly through MCP or authenticated API tools, without driving the web interface.

Connect an MCP-capable host once. The Python stdio client can automatically create and reconnect to a separate Free service account. Existing customers can provide their own account API key. A page URL alone does not install tools in every AI product. External data credentials and the host's permissions remain required. Only active Plus and Pro plans can omit platform attribution.

## Connect and operate

- [Choose Codex, Claude Code or Cursor](https://swipies.app/agents.html#swipies-setup): Generate client-specific setup using your local client file path.

- [Full agent instructions](https://swipies.app/llms-full.txt): Authentication, automatic setup, MCP tools, examples, limits and supported scope. Read this before making changes.
- [Connection guide](https://swipies.app/agents.html): Human-readable setup and examples.
- [Discovery JSON](https://swipies.app/agent-access.json): URLs, capabilities, branding rules and exclusions.
- [Gateway OpenAPI](https://swipies.app/agent-access.openapi.json): The four public Agent Access gateway endpoints; tenant operations are discovered dynamically.
- [Stdio client source](https://swipies.app/downloads/swipies_agent_client.py.txt): Save as swipies_agent_client.py. Python 3.10+; standard library only; automatic Free account setup and reconnect.

## Live API

- [Runtime manifest](https://api.swipies.app/api/v1/agent-access/manifest): Authoritative server transport, registration and branding information. Send User-Agent: SwipiesAgent/1.0 from API clients.
- [Tenant operation catalog](https://api.swipies.app/api/v1/agent-access/operations): Requires a bearer API key. Discover exact operation IDs and paths before execution.

## Optional

- [Platform](https://swipies.app/): Product overview and current plans.
- [Help](https://help.swipies.app/docs/dev/): General platform documentation.

The current generic MCP catalog excludes administration, payments, token management, OAuth callbacks and Ads. Never infer credentials, privileges or provider access from this documentation.
